data.name: Ashiyana
data.gender_notes: Ashiyana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashiyana is a name that signifies a tranquil and peaceful dwelling or home, symbolizing serenity and comfort. The name Ashiyana carries the meaning “Tranquil, peaceful abode” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ashiyana usually hope their child will grow to embody tranquil, peaceful abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The concept of a peaceful home is reflected in the Quranic description of Paradise as a place of peace and tranquility.
data.etymology: Ashiyana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tranquil, peaceful abode.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashiyana total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عشيانا
in_arabic.meaning: عشيانا تعني المأوى أو الدار أو مكان الإقامة
in_arabic.long_meaning: عشيانا هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ش-ي' والذي يحمل معاني المأوى والإقامة والدار. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى مكان الراحة والسكينة. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة دينية وروحية.

in_urdu.name: عشيانہ
in_urdu.meaning: عشيانہ کا مطلب ہے مسکن یا گھر یا رہائش گاہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عشيانہ ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جو 'ع-ش-ي' جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رہائش گاہ، گھر، یا آشیانہ۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اس کا استعمال مسلموں کے بچوں کے لیے ایک مقبول انتخاب کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आशियाना
in_hindi.meaning: आशियाना का अर्थ है निवास स्थान या घर
in_hindi.long_meaning: आशियाना एक इस्लामी नाम है जो अरबी जड़ 'ع-ش-ي' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है निवास स्थान, घर या आश्रय। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है और इसका उपयोग बच्चों के नामकरण में किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عشيانا
in_pashto.meaning: عشيانا دى مېنځنګاه يا د اوسيدو ځاى
in_pashto.long_meaning: عشيانا د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دى چې د عربي جذر 'ع-ش-ي' څخه اخستل شوى دى، کوم چې د مېنځنګاه، د اوسيدو ځاى يا کور مانا لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديز ارزښتونو برخه ده او د مسلمو ماشومانو لپاره کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Ashiyana
in_english.meaning: Ashiyana means dwelling, residence, or abode
in_english.long_meaning: Ashiyana is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic root 'ع-ش-ي', which signifies a dwelling, residence, or abode. Its usage spans across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a place of rest and tranquility.

It is believed that the name was derived from the Arabic word "sahna" which means rest, peace, and tranquility. The art of calligraphy and poetry are deeply ingrained in Islamic culture, and the name Ashiyana could be a beautiful addition to a verse as it symbolizes a peaceful dwelling in both this life and the hereafter.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Ashiyana can be seen as a reminder of the importance of creating a peaceful and tranquil environment within ourselves and our homes. It is believed that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Paradise is under the shade of swords," emphasizing the importance of creating a peaceful and tranquil inner state, as well as in our external surroundings. The name Ashiyana can serve as a constant reminder of this spiritual objective, encouraging us to strive for inner peace and tranquility, which ultimately leads to a closer relationship with Allah (Swt) and the realization of His blessings in our lives.
